hypothesis_title: 약세 예측 엔진 v2.0 — calibration + cost-sensitive + threshold optim + W3 stratified retrain + Phase B 12 features
hypothesis_description:
v1.0 (WT-D20260519_002) REJECT_DESIGN_INVALIDATION (Forge G1 5/5 HARD FAIL, Recall@0.5=0 모든 window, OPT9 TDC=0.75 ≥ 0.7 reject, Path B 5-layer all ΔSR negative vs L5_V2 baseline, Lockbox bear sensor zero value).

Root cause: ensemble probability calibration failure (raw prob biased to base rate ~0.13, τ=0.5 never reached).

v2.0 mandate 4 axes:
1. Platt scaling 또는 isotonic regression calibration MANDATORY
2. Cost-sensitive classifier (class weight = 1/base_rate ~ 8.6)
3. Threshold optimization (Youden J 또는 cost-weighted)
4. W3 feature drift stratified retrain (Pesaran-Timmermann 2007, 3 macro regimes)

Phase B direct data collection: VKOSPI / SEIBro / KR_credit / KR_LEI / KRX foreign flow (12/32 deferred features). Charter v1.7 §10 lineage inherit v1.0.
